summary: 1936 L-4 cabin on a ground site about 10 miles SE of Spotted Bear Ranger Station, Flathead NF; listed Gone; no source describes the site today.

evidence.supports: about 10 miles SE of Spotted Bear Ranger Station
evidence.quote: 10 miles southeast of Spotted Bear R.S.

evidence.supports: coordinates, Ground site type, status Gone
L-4 cab was a 14 by 14 foot frame cab made to live in
evidence.quote: 14'x14' frame cabs were made to live in and could be placed atop tall firetowers.

evidence.supports: L-4 originated in 1929 as a prototype (attributed to Ray Kresek)
evidence.quote: L-4 originated in 1929 as a prototype with its windows laying sideways instead of upright.

notes_for_editor: The 1936 date and L-4 design come from one page (firelookout.com); the county list confirms the Ground type and Gone status. Do not confuse with Meadow Peak in Flathead County (US 344, standing NHLR tower, see us-mt-meadow-peak) or the Oregon and Washington Meadow Mountain sites. No source describes the site today.
